⏺ Scammers now use AI deepfakes of famous people on fake livestreams
⏺ The pitch is always the same: send crypto, get double back

2️⃣ Why It Happens — AI can now copy a famous face and voice convincingly. A hijacked channel with a real-looking stream makes it feel official.
3️⃣ Example — This week a fake Tesla stream with a deepfake Elon Musk drew over 500,000 viewers. Coinbase says its AI blocked about $4.7 million that customers tried to send.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — YouTube and X livestreams, QR codes on screen, "limited time" countdowns and fake comment sections full of "I got paid!"
5️⃣ Practical Rule — If anyone promises to send back more crypto than you send, it is a scam. Every time. Close the stream and report it.
Final Thoughts

A crypto transfer can't be undone. No celebrity, exchange or project needs your coins to "verify" a giveaway — real airdrops never ask you to pay first.

- Transformer blocks.

The material is designed for readers with a basic mathematical background. Code examples in Python are used to illustrate the concepts.

This is an excellent resource for those who want to understand the mathematical foundations of modern language models.

Israel could withdraw from parts of Syria while retaining warning posts and the right to intervene there, according to a report on Israel’s Channel 14. Damascus would get territory back with Israeli security provisions still attached.

The channel, citing an unnamed Syrian source close to the government, reports that a U.S.-mediated interim arrangement would also require Syria to abandon its historic claim to the Golan Heights. The source describes the issue as potentially resolvable. Damascus has given no final answer or official confirmation.

Under the reported terms, Israel would retain Mount Hermon’s summit and other strategic positions. Areas it vacated would become a demilitarized security strip, with Syria responsible for keeping armed forces out. The extent of the Israeli withdrawal remains disputed.

The central security bargain would enlist Damascus in blocking Iranian weapons routes to Hezbollah. Joining the Abraham Accords is not currently on the table, and no agreement has been signed.

The proposed exchange is striking. Syria would relinquish a territorial claim while Israel negotiates how many of the positions it took after Assad’s fall in December 2024 to give up. The agreement would be called interim. Some of its concessions could last much longer.

U.S. District Judge Patricia Tolliver Giles accepted his guilty plea in Alexandria, Virginia, with sentencing scheduled for March 4, 2027.

📊 Court documents show that Yaroch worked at the FBI’s Boston Division between 2017 and early 2025, where he was assigned to a squad investigating an adversarial nation-state. He subsequently transferred to the Counterintelligence and Espionage Division in February 2025, gaining access to FBI systems containing cryptocurrency credentials obtained during criminal and intelligence investigations. 

⚡️ Prosecutors said his thefts began no later than December 2024, before he moved to the new division. Using credentials associated with investigations outside his authorized activities, Yaroch accessed cryptocurrency wallets and transferred funds without permission. The approximately 100 fraudulent transactions involved credentials connected to 35 separate FBI investigations. Authorities calculated his total illicit proceeds at $2,474,380.66, substantially exceeding the roughly $1 million initially identified when his activities became public.

🪙 THE YEAR SILVER LEFT AMERICA’S POCKET CHANGE

On July 23, 1965, President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Coinage Act of 1965. Until then, U.S. dimes, quarters and half dollars were 90 percent silver.

“When I have signed this bill before me, we will have made the first fundamental change in our coinage in 173 years,” Johnson said at the signing. The new dimes and quarters had no silver at all, just copper-nickel faces bonded to a copper core. The half dollar dropped to 40 percent silver, and silver was dropped from it entirely in 1971.

That is why collectors still check dates. A 90 percent silver dime holds about 0.072 troy ounce of pure silver, so $1 in face value of pre-1965 dimes or quarters holds about 0.72 ounce of silver.
